name: learn-from-video
description: Turn any video into a comprehensive Word-document learning report. Bundles /watch (yt-dlp download, scene-aware ffmpeg frames, captions or Whisper transcript) as the ingestion engine and /learn-from-video as the report generator.

interface.shortDescription: Paste a video URL — get a full Word-document study report back.
interface.longDescription: learn-from-video adds two skills. /watch gives the agent a video input: it downloads with yt-dlp, extracts scene-aware frames with ffmpeg, and pulls a timestamped transcript from native captions (or the Whisper API as a fallback). /learn-from-video builds on that engine to produce a comprehensive .docx report that weaves what was said together with what was shown — screenshots embedded inline, code recovered from the screen and completed to working examples, and diagrams recreated as Mermaid.
defaultPrompt: /watch https://youtu.be/<id> what happens at the 30 second mark?
create detailed notes from these two videos on the same topic
